test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The tigress was trailing the stag.

options.text: The stag was trailing by the tigress.
The stag was being trailed by the tigress.
The stag had been trailed by the tigress.
The stag was trailed by the tigress.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 2)** "The stag was being trailed by the tigress" is the **correct passive form.**
 
• **It correctly uses** the past progressive form of the verb "be" (was being) followed by the past participle form of the verb "trail" (trailed).
 
• **This form conveys **that the stag was in the process of being trailed by the tigress.
 
• Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'The stag was being trailed by the tigress.'*
